# ShelfSpace
> Managed accounts payable, consignment, and credit recovery for cannabis dispensaries.
> Website: https://shelfspace.pro
> Contact: https://shelfspace.pro/contact
> Email: chris@shelfspace.pro

## What is ShelfSpace?
ShelfSpace is a managed service that handles vendor finances for cannabis dispensaries. We run accounts payable, consignment settlements, and vendor credit recovery — the retailer just approves payments. Our goal is that the retailer never needs to log in. We do the tedious AP work, save them money, and send them the reports.

Founded by Chris Mitchem, a 10-year cannabis dispensary operator who built ShelfSpace to solve the problems he lived with every day. Not a tech company — an operator who got tired of the broken system.

## Three Services

### Consignment (https://shelfspace.pro/consignment)
- Retailers carry vendor inventory with zero upfront cost — pay only when product sells at the register
- ShelfSpace runs weekly settlements: pulls POS data, calculates profit splits, generates five-page settlement reports, and cuts Check 21 compliant checks for every vendor
- Frees up approximately $250,000 in capital for the average dispensary (based on $2M annual revenue, 50% COGS, 90-day inventory on hand)
- The vendor owns inventory until it's sold — zero inventory risk for the retailer
- Unsold product can be returned to the vendor at no cost

### Credit Recovery (https://shelfspace.pro/credit-recovery)
- ShelfSpace recovers an average of $50,000 per year per retailer in vendor credits
- Three types of credits recovered: product returns, expired product, and co-marketing/promotional credits
- We pull POS and METRC data, create credit memos line by line, work with vendors to get approval, and apply credits to settlements
- The retailer does nothing — we handle all vendor communication and credit tracking
- Interactive calculator available at https://shelfspace.pro/credit-recovery to estimate recovery potential

### Accounts Payable (https://shelfspace.pro/accounts-payable)
- Managed AP service — we pay all vendors (cannabis and non-cannabis), verify invoices before payment, handle vendor questions, and sync everything to QuickBooks
- Saves approximately $45,000 per year in labor, errors, and missed credits
- We onboard vendors with just an email address — no paperwork, no bank details needed
- Every vendor gets a free portal to download checks, view payment history, and track status
- Retailers approve every payment — nothing goes out without their sign-off
- Vendors email ShelfSpace with questions, not the retailer

## Payment System
- All payments are Check 21 Act compliant — valid Substitute Checks under Federal Law
- Checks are print-at-home legal and mobile deposit ready
- Every payment syncs to QuickBooks in real time — no manual journal entries
- Full audit trail on every transaction — who created it, when issued, when downloaded, current status
- Void and reissue any check with a single click

## Vendor Portal
- Every vendor gets a free portal at no cost
- Features: instant check downloads, complete payment history, real-time notifications, multi-retailer dashboard
- Vendors working with multiple ShelfSpace retailers see all their data in one view
- Cannabis and non-cannabis vendors supported

## Pricing (https://shelfspace.pro/pricing)
- Free 60-day pilot with full platform access, all features, unlimited vendors
- After the pilot, pricing is based on what ShelfSpace recovers and manages for you
- Most operators pay less than 15% of the credit value recovered — and that includes running their entire consignment and AP operation
- No contracts, no minimums, cancel any time
- Vendors never pay to receive payment

## Technology
- Integrates with any cannabis POS system: Dutchie, Flowhub, BLAZE, Cova, Treez, Alleaves, MJ Freeway, Meadow, IndicaOnline, and more
- POS integration via CSV upload or direct API
- METRC compatible — inventory manifested in METRC using existing protocols
- QuickBooks sync on all payments
- ShelfiQ AI advisor built in — ask questions about vendors, inventory, settlements, and credits in plain English
- Row-level security, multi-tenant data isolation, zero hard deletes
- Cloud-based, available anywhere cannabis is legal in the United States

## Case Study
A two-shop dispensary chain in Massachusetts:
- $50,000+/year in vendor credits recovered
- 40+ vendors managed across 2 locations
- $45,000/year saved on AP and operations payroll
- Vendors transitioned to consignment to free up capital
- Vendors report improved payment reliability and portal access
